items.quote: “Sonam was born with a meningocele between her nose and head. The surgery cost lakhs we could never have raised on a daily wage. Surgery Care arranged the funds and the operation — today she is back at school, healthy and happy.”
items.name: Sonam's Family

items.quote: “My son Raubi had a fast-growing cancerous tumour on his chin and could barely eat or speak. As a daily-wage labourer I had no way to pay for the urgent surgery. Surgery Care made it happen — he is now playing and eating without pain.”
items.name: Raubi's Father

items.quote: “Our newborn was diagnosed with spina bifida myelomeningocele. The surgery cost ₹2.5 lakh — impossible on ₹300 a day. Surgery Care's team handled everything. The operation was a success and our baby is growing well.”
items.name: Priya & Pawan

items.question: How do I know my donation actually reaches the patient?
items.answer: Donations are sent directly to the hospital that performs the surgery, never to a patient or family bank account. Every case is medically verified before it goes live, and our team coordinates the admission and stays with the family through recovery so every rupee is accounted for.

items.question: How do you choose the hospitals you work with?
items.answer: We work only with established, accredited hospitals. Every partner is reviewed by our team before any patient is referred there, so the clinical quality and safety standards are consistent across our network.

items.question: What kinds of cases do you support?
items.answer: We support patients of all ages who need surgical care they cannot afford, including children with congenital conditions, cancer patients, burn-injury cases, and other critical surgical needs. Every case is medically reviewed and verified before it goes live.

items.question: How are donations used and tracked?
items.answer: Funds raised for a patient are transferred directly to the hospital that performs the surgery. Our team verifies every case, coordinates the admission, and accompanies the family through the treatment so every rupee goes to care. T&C applied.

items: No family should choose between treatment and survival.
Healing should never depend on a bank balance.

about.heroSubtitle: Surgery Care connects patients to top hospitals across India and ensures every patient, affordable or not, receives high-quality surgical treatment.
about.companyBody: As a healthcare-focused organisation, our main focus is to improve the health of every patient by consulting and treating them at top hospitals with strong team coordination, for both affordable and non-affordable patients alike.
about.valueDirectImpactDescription: Every donation funds a verified surgical case at a partnered hospital.
about.valueVerifiedCasesDescription: Each medical case is reviewed by our team and admitted to a NABH-accredited hospital.
about.valueEndToEndDescription: From counselling and admission to post-operative recovery, our team stays with every patient.
about.conditionsHeading: Surgical care across paediatric, oncology and complex cases
about.conditionsBody: Surgery Care supports patients with a wide range of surgical needs. Below are the conditions our network of partner hospitals regularly treats.
missionPoints: Support financially vulnerable patients requiring surgeries.
Build a community-powered healthcare assistance system.
Connect patients with hospitals, doctors and healthcare experts.
Promote healthcare awareness and preventive care education.
Encourage public participation in humanitarian healthcare initiatives.
Create transparent and trustworthy healthcare support processes.
Empower families with guidance during medical emergencies.
neverDoItems: We do not take commission from any party.
We do not sell treatment packages.
about.visionStatement: To create an inclusive healthcare support network where no patient is denied treatment because of financial hardship, lack of awareness, or limited access to medical resources.
about.closingTagline: To stand beside every patient when they need humanity the most.
about.donationBody: Every rupee follows the same path: a verified case, a public collection, and direct settlement to the hospital that performs the surgery.
about.donationStep1Description: Our team reviews medical records, hospital estimates and the family's situation before any campaign goes live.
about.donationStep2Description: Donors contribute through verified payment gateways. Every contribution is tracked against the patient's goal in real time.
about.donationStep3Description: Funds are released directly to the hospital that performs the surgery. They never enter a patient or family bank account.
about.promisesBody: Trust starts with what we refuse. These are non-negotiable rules that govern every campaign listed on Surgery Care Foundation.
about.registrationsBody: Surgery Care Foundation is registered under Indian non-profit law and holds the certifications below. Documents are available on written request.
about.regNgoDescription: Surgery Care Foundation is a registered non-profit entity under Indian law.
about.reg12aDescription: Income-tax exemption status under Section 12A of the Income Tax Act.
about.reg80gDescription: Donors receive tax-deduction benefit under Section 80G on every donation.
about.regPanDescription: Permanent Account Number available for compliance verification.
about.goalsBody: We believe patients deserve timely access to healthcare, and our systems are built to reflect that value at every step.
about.goalValuesDescription: Honest and open communication with patients and partner hospitals at every stage of treatment.
about.goalIntegrityDescription: Fairness and self-scrutiny in everything we do. The ideal way to protect patient safety, confidentiality and privacy.
